CourseName: CEN3722 - Introduction to Human Computer Interfaces

Assignments.Title: HCI Foundations — Module 1 Group Project: Team Formation & Project Kickoff
Assignments.TopicTitles: Introduction to Human-Computer Interaction, Version Control with GitHub, Design Collaboration with Figma, AI Tools in HCI and Development, Development Environment Setup, Team Collaboration and Project Kickoff
Assignments.ExtraInstructions:
Students should be informed they are going to design and build  a commercial level product. They may choose from the proudct ideas added to the bottom of the assignment. The product can be developed as a Windows Application, Web Application, Mobile Application (Android or iOS). Students will not only design and build, they will also go through the full publication cycle of putting the product into the store. (Professor will provide assistance and accounts as needed).  

Students must as a team, decide on a Figma account, Github account, and develop a protocol of how they will communicate and work as  team. This submission must cover;
Students in group and existing skill sets
Leadership structure of team
Responsibility for account maintenance (Github, Figma)
How students will communicate and manage the project.
